scope: ASMT-04 re-diagnosis closure after applying a PATH repair
status: implemented-and-isolated-ui-verified; no real user PATH was written
implementation: apply_path_repair now returns PathRepairResult instead of the requested plan
after the write it re-reads the registry and recomputes the result from the live PATH
verified is true only when the live user PATH equals the applied plan and no command still resolves to another installation
the result reports the live user PATH, per-command resolution, concrete problems and requiresNewTerminal
verify_path_repair_at accepts an explicit merged PATH order so fixtures never depend on the host registry
the environments page distinguishes 已调整 PATH 顺序并核验 from 已写入，但核验未通过, and explains that an open terminal or a system PATH entry may be the cause

uiCoverage.release-052-ui: a verified repair asserts 已调整 PATH 顺序并核验 and the managed-entry-first message; an unverified repair asserts 核验未通过 plus the still-shadowed reason

ui.command: node tests/run-ui.mjs <global playwright module> tests/settings-ui.mjs tests/startup-ui.mjs tests/release-052-ui.mjs tests/download-ui.mjs tests/package-manager-update-ui.mjs tests/scans-ui.mjs tests/scan-ui.mjs tests/sizes-ui.mjs tests/packages-ui.mjs

notVerified: No real user PATH was reordered; the verification was exercised with injected PATH states
No new terminal was opened to confirm the reported resolution
The UI path used a simulated backend only
limitations: The verification inspects the registry value, so it cannot detect a running shell that still holds the old environment
A system PATH entry ahead of the user entry still shows as shadowed, which is reported rather than auto-fixed
The result does not persist an audit record beyond the existing PATH journal entry
